name: macos-nix-daemon-readiness
claims: the exact product readiness shell block is extracted and executed
Linux ordinary store ping succeeds without daemon-only assumptions
macOS retries the installed Nix daemon with a finite 20-attempt bound
macOS exports NIX_REMOTE=daemon only after a successful daemon ping
the product repository evaluates its locked Nixpkgs input after readiness
the Nix client does not fall back to root-owned direct store database access
non_claims: Nix daemon recovery from a permanently broken installation
multi-user Nix installation outside GitHub-hosted runners
